```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library("mvtnorm")
library("tidyverse")
library("tidymodels")
library("discrim")
library("kableExtra")
library("kknn")
library("e1071")
library("caret")

set.seed(123)

generate_data <- function(scenario) {
  if (scenario == 1) {
    mu1 <- c(1.25, 1)
    mu2 <- c(1, 1.25)
    sigma1 <- diag(2)
    sigma2 <- diag(2)
    n1 <- n2 <- 20
  } else if (scenario == 2) {
    mu1 <- c(1.25, 1)
    mu2 <- c(1, 1.25)
    sigma1 <- sigma2 <- matrix(c(2, -0.5, -0.5, 2), 2, 2)
    n1 <- n2 <- 20
  } else if (scenario == 3) {
    mu1 <- c(1.25, 1)
    mu2 <- c(1, 1.25)
    sigma <- matrix(c(2, -0.5, -0.5, 2), 2, 2)
    n1 <- n2 <- 50
    x1 <- rmvt(n1, sigma = sigma, df = 3) + matrix(mu1, n1, 2, byrow = TRUE)
    x2 <- rmvt(n2, sigma = sigma, df = 3) + matrix(mu2, n2, 2, byrow = TRUE)
    return(list(data = data.frame(rbind(x1, x2), y = factor(rep(c(1, 2), each = n1))), test = NULL))
  } else if (scenario == 4) {
    mu1 <- c(1.25, 1)
    mu2 <- c(1, 1.25)
    sigma1 <- matrix(c(1, 0.5, 0.5, 1), 2, 2)
    sigma2 <- matrix(c(1, -0.5, -0.5, 1), 2, 2)
    n1 <- n2 <- 20
  } else if (scenario == 5) {
    n <- 50
    X <- rmvnorm(n, mean = c(0, 0), sigma = diag(2))
    eta <- 0.1 * X[,1] - X[,2] + 2 * X[,1] * X[,2] + 0.5 * X[,2]
    prob <- exp(eta) / (1 + exp(eta))
    y <- rbinom(n, 1, prob)
    return(list(data = data.frame(X1 = X[,1], X2 = X[,2], y = factor(y)), test = NULL))
  } else if (scenario == 6) {
    mu1 <- c(1.25, 1)
    mu2 <- c(1, 1.25)
    sigma1 <- matrix(c(5, 0, 0, 2), 2, 2)
    sigma2 <- matrix(c(1, 0, 0, 4), 2, 2)
    n1 <- n2 <- 6
  }

  if (scenario != 3 && scenario != 5) {
    x1 <- rmvnorm(n1, mean = mu1, sigma = sigma1)
    x2 <- rmvnorm(n2, mean = mu2, sigma = sigma2)
    train <- data.frame(rbind(x1, x2), y = factor(rep(c(1, 2), each = n1)))
    test <- data.frame(rbind(rmvnorm(1000, mu1, sigma1), rmvnorm(1000, mu2, sigma2)), 
                       y = factor(rep(c(1, 2), each = 1000)))
    colnames(test)[1:2] <- c("X1", "X2")
    return(list(data = train, test = test))
  }
}

fit_models <- function(train) {
  models <- list()
  train <- train %>% rename(X1 = X1, X2 = X2)

  models$log_reg <- glm(y ~ ., data = train, family = binomial)
  models$lda <- discrim_linear() %>% set_engine("MASS") %>% fit(y ~ ., data = train)
  models$qda <- discrim_quad() %>% set_engine("MASS") %>% fit(y ~ ., data = train)
  models$knn1 <- train(y ~ ., data = train, method = "kknn", tuneGrid = data.frame(kmax = 1, distance = 2, kernel = "rectangular"))
  models$knn_cv <- train(y ~ ., data = train, method = "kknn", trControl = trainControl("cv", number = 5))
  models$nb <- naiveBayes(y ~ ., data = train)

  return(models)
}

predict_models <- function(models, test) {
  test <- test %>% rename(X1 = X1, X2 = X2)
  
  preds <- sapply(names(models), function(name) {
    model <- models[[name]]
    
    if (name == "log_reg") {
      prob <- predict(model, newdata = test, type = "response")
      factor(ifelse(prob > 0.5, 2, 1), levels = c(1, 2))
    
    } else if (inherits(model, "train")) {
      predict(model, newdata = test)
    
    } else if (name %in% c("lda", "qda")) {
      predict(model, new_data = test)$.pred_class  # tidymodels engine
    
    } else if (name == "nb") {
      predict(model, newdata = test)  # e1071 naiveBayes
    
    } else {
      stop(paste("Unknown model:", name))
    }
  })
  
  colnames(preds) <- names(models)
  return(preds)
}


evaluate_accuracy <- function(preds, truth) {
  apply(preds, 2, function(p) mean(p == truth))
}

results <- list()

for (scenario in 1:6) {
  scenario_acc <- replicate(10, {
    dat <- generate_data(scenario)
    models <- fit_models(dat$data)
    if (!is.null(dat$test)) {
      preds <- predict_models(models, dat$test)
      acc <- evaluate_accuracy(preds, dat$test$y)
      acc
    } else {
      rep(NA, 6)
    }
  })
  results[[paste0("Scenario_", scenario)]] <- data.frame(t(scenario_acc))
}

results_df <- bind_rows(results, .id = "Scenario")
results_df_long <- results_df %>%
  pivot_longer(-Scenario, names_to = "Model", values_to = "Accuracy")

ggplot(results_df_long, aes(x = Model, y = Accuracy, fill = Model)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~Scenario) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
